scope: Prospective method critique of root-relayed user instruction to make mathematical final allocation total 100%; no running experiment edits or postprocessing performed by this note

proportional_scaling.interpretation: 8 percentage points of missing total budget is distinct from an 8.695652% relative increase in every positive raw weight.

concrete_reasoning_risks.effect: Raw weight is below the comparator; normalized weight is above it. The original model statement slightly above benchmark remains false about its submitted raw vector.
Model explains a 38% decision. A 41.304348% normalized weight is created by the mechanical rule, not that stated model choice.

recommended_contract.eligibility: Strict whole-response JSON; exactly 11 unique known sectors; finite real numeric weights excluding booleans; nonnegative; strictly positive sum. Preserve failures for absent, duplicate, negative, nonfinite, malformed or all-zero vectors. Never impute equal weights.
recommended_contract.raw_above_one: If accepted by the universal nonnegative-positive-sum rule, retain original above-one failure explicitly; normalization only makes a mathematical portfolio, not reliable source reasoning.
recommended_contract.exact_arithmetic: Use original serialized numeric tokens via Decimal/Fraction. Preserve raw values, residual and normalized rational values; do not claim an exact float sum.
recommended_contract.display_rule: Predeclare 10000 integer units for 0.01% resolution; floor each exact quota, allocate remaining units by largest fractional remainder, ties by fixed sector order.
recommended_contract.canonical_final_choice: Distinguish high-precision normalized proportions from displayed rounded integer units. Explicitly state which defines actual final allocation and use that same vector for derived arithmetic.
recommended_contract.provenance: Bind output hash, algorithm/version, eligibility, raw total/residual, scaling factor, normalized values, rounding units, row changes and exact final-unit total. No endpoint response overwrite.
recommended_contract.failure_interpretation: A derived vector must not upgrade an unbound or failed transport to a completed model response. Complete diagnostic vectors require explicit provenance/availability status.

reporting_policy: Retain original raw arithmetic/source/claim diagnostics and planned denominators.
Never use normalized weights to retroactively rescue a model statement about its raw weight, baseline tilt or D0-to-F0 change.
Report model-produced raw D0/F0 deltas separately from rule-produced deltas; do not attribute mechanical changes to source reasoning.
Apply the same frozen mathematical rule to all E/L/C cells and do not select a rule based on favorable semantic output.
Derived comparisons are a post-start user-directed amendment/secondary analysis, not the original prespecified raw endpoint or evidence that a semantic defect was repaired.
No valid-allocation distance should be assigned to an invalid raw vector; comparisons among eligible derived normalized vectors are separately labeled.
Do not infer that rounding caused the budget defect; distinguish proportional scaling from a final display-quantization step.

three_axes.errors: Arithmetic can be enforced exactly using integer allocation units; source, unit, date and rationale errors remain independently measured.
three_axes.consistency: Separate raw, normalized and display-quantized values; use one declared final vector and exact rounding tie policy across all cells.
three_axes.paper_topic: The unit of interpretation becomes model plus a deterministic budget rule for derived operational allocations. Preserve the model evidence-to-choice question by retaining raw choices and separate semantic evaluation.
